question: Should QQBot permanently reject gateway events above 1 MiB, or should this PR use a more conservative ceiling such as the 16 MiB sibling precedent?
rationale: The dependency behavior and hardening value are clear, but QQ does not publish a gateway envelope maximum; selecting a fail-closed threshold determines whether future legitimate events can disconnect the channel.

options.title: Use 16 MiB ceiling
options.body: Raise the limit to 16 MiB to preserve substantial protection from the inherited 100 MiB window while reducing unsupported compatibility and delivery risk.

options.title: Accept 1 MiB ceiling
options.body: Keep the current value with explicit QQBot owner acceptance that any larger gateway event should close the connection.

options.title: Pause for production evidence
options.body: Hold the PR until authenticated QQ traffic or an upstream contract establishes a defensible maximum event size.

recommendation.title: Use 16 MiB ceiling
recommendation.body: Raise the limit to 16 MiB to preserve substantial protection from the inherited 100 MiB window while reducing unsupported compatibility and delivery risk.

likelyOwner.reason: The permanent ceiling belongs with the contributor most closely tied to the current QQBot gateway architecture and event model.
